instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Indoors near a bright window, the person in the striped shirt and glasses (R2) stands on the left, facing right and smiling. The person in the light green waffle-knit shirt (R1) stands on the right, facing left in profile. They embrace closely; R2's right hand rests gently on R1's shoulder near the neck, while R1's arm wraps around R2's waist. Soft natural light from the window illuminates the couple, creating a warm, intimate mood with a neutral color palette.
